intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Dawn turns the Sunken Ford the color of watered rust; smoke still curls from the tollhouse rafters.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Grok'tar's gnolls butchered the watch at midnight. If they hold the shallows, Thornwick burns by supper.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
intro_scene.line: My ferryman's ledger is locked inside The Tollhouse Strongbox. Leave it to the fire and half the valley forgets who owes whom.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Forget your coin, Fenwick. We wade in under arrow cover, take the bluff, and drop Grok'tar before his pack scents blood.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Keep the archers on the ridge. We cross where the current runs shallowest.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Shields up! Do not let their spear-throwers pin us waist-deep in the current!

milestones.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
milestones.line: The tollhouse beams are sagging—check the charred floorboards for The Tollhouse Strongbox!

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Hold your footing! Slip on these stones and the river carries you straight to their cleavers!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Grok'tar is alone on the bluff. Cut his banner down and end this.

ambient_barks: Snarling gnolls clash iron shields together.
Arrows hiss into the red current.
Hold the gravel bar, men!
Grok'tar bellows from the limestone bluff.
Wet leather creaks under heavy mail.
The burning tollhouse roof caves inward.
Keep your blades above the water!
A wounded raider splashes downstream.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: Grok'tar's rag of a banner is halfway to the estuary. Good work—though these orders from the watchtower are no gnoll scrawl.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
victory_epilogue.line: The river remembers every toll paid in iron. Still, my punt is yours whenever the marsh calls.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Someone paid to put those gnolls at the ford. Let us find out who.

m01-blood-at-the-ford.defeat_line: The river washes red over broken shields as gnoll horns echo unopposed down the Thornwick road.

optional_choice.prompt: The burning tollhouse is collapsing around an iron strongbox and a trapped watchman.
optional_choice.a: Pull the wounded watchman clear before the roof falls.
optional_choice.b: Drag the scorched strongbox out of the embers first.
optional_choice.effect_a: Lose 40 gold in melted coin; gain a veteran spearman recruit and +10 Thornwick morale.
optional_choice.effect_b: Gain 120 gold and tax writs; Garrick condemns your greed (-10 garrison morale until m04).

m01-blood-at-the-ford.codex_note: The Sunken Ford marks the ancient basalt shelf where the northern trade road crosses the Redwater. Three border treaties were signed on its gravel banks and broken before the ink dried.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Mist clings to the drowned willows like wet wool, swallowing footsteps ten paces out.

intro_scene.speaker: field-scout-bren
intro_scene.line: They hit my patrol at the sedge-line... poisoned barbs. The whole host is massing behind Ravenwatch, not the ford.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: His veins are already turning black. Keep him breathing till the stone post, and scrape any Bile of the Fen you find off their blades.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Slow march, tight flanks. If Bren dies in the bog, we march blind into whatever is waiting north.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Heavy shields outside. Burn the willow nests as we pass.

milestones.speaker: field-scout-bren
milestones.line: In the branches—above the water! Watch the green-fletched shafts!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: That black ooze on their arrowheads is Bile of the Fen—deadly, yet priceless for antivenom.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: More bog-stalkers wading in from the reeds! Close ranks around the litter!

milestones.speaker: field-scout-bren
milestones.line: Leave me by the cairn if you must... just get the count of their banners to Thornwick...

ambient_barks: Poisoned shafts hiss from willow limbs.
Boots squelch deep in black peat.
Marsh gas bubbles beneath rotting logs.
A bitter cough echoes through fog.
Check your flanks—reeds are moving!
Carrion crows watch from drowned oaks.
Antivenom vials clink against belt buckles.
Something heavy slides beneath the duckweed.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-scout-bren
victory_epilogue.line: The watch post... still standing. Take the garrison ledgers under the hearthstone—every tally leads to Ravenwatch.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: One more league and the poison would have stopped his heart. Now we brew a cure before the next ambush.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: The ford was bait. Ravenwatch is the jaw.

m02-whispers-in-the-fen.defeat_line: The fen drinks the last torchlight, leaving only bubbles where your vanguard sank beneath poisoned reeds.

optional_choice.prompt: Bren's fever spikes midway across the causeway, slowing the column under archer fire.
optional_choice.a: Spend Marta's last concentrated antitoxin to stabilize Bren immediately.
optional_choice.b: Force-march the litter without stopping to treat the wound.
optional_choice.effect_a: Lose 1 Rare Antitoxin consumable; Bren survives healthy and reveals ambush caches in Act II (m14).
optional_choice.effect_b: Save supplies, but Bren suffers permanent nerve damage (-15% scouting vision through m06).

m02-whispers-in-the-fen.codex_note: Drowned three centuries ago when an earthquake dammed the Greywater, the Fen is a maze of peat islands and sunken causeways favored by smugglers and marsh-born cultists.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Ravenwatch Keep squats on a basalt tooth, its gatehouse stinking of wet ash and butchered rooks.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: The portcullis is twisted like melted tallow. We lock shields in the inner bailey until first light, then burn their totems.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: Look at the outer wall—The Broken Picket. Someone pulled the iron stakes from the inside before the horns blew.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Those bone totems in the treeline are feeding witchfire into the courtyard. Hold the line until the chanting falters.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Form the circle. Nobody steps past the wellhead until dawn.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: They're pouring through the gatehouse! Lock shields and brace your heels!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: Green witchfire is eating the mortar! Three totems in the pines—sunder them as soon as dawn breaks!

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: My hammer's notched to the haft, captain, and they keep coming out of the dark!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: First light. Break the circle—burn those bone totems down to splinters.

ambient_barks: Claws scrape across battered iron shields.
Sickly green witchfire crackles overhead.
Hold the bailey wellhead!
Bone chimes rattle in the pines.
A trebuchet timber groans and snaps.
Howls answer howls beyond the curtain wall.
Dawn grey bleeds over the ridge.
Shatter the cursed totem poles!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: The totems are dust and the courtyard is ours. Look beneath the collapsed shrine—stairs cut straight into the bedrock.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
victory_epilogue.line: Dwarven masonry under an imperial keep. Whoever opened The Broken Picket wanted us looking at the walls, not below.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Light fresh torches. We go down.

m03-nightfall-at-ravenwatch.defeat_line: Dawn never reaches the inner bailey; beneath a canopy of pale witchfire, Ravenwatch becomes an ossuary.
m03-nightfall-at-ravenwatch.codex_note: Erected atop an older subterranean vault, Ravenwatch Keep served as the Empire's northern listening post until its garrison stopped sending winter dispatches.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Below Ravenwatch, black water laps against drowned pillars where candle-grease drips like pale stalactites.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Mordred the Ashen was stripped of his robes in the capital twenty years ago. He trades blood for things that sleep in silt.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Those causeways are two shields wide at best. One shove and a man in plate sinks like an anvil.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: And watch the steps behind us—older arches lead straight into the black water.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Keep casters in the center. Watch the water behind us.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Ashen retainers on the bridge! Narrow front—do not let them wrap our flanks!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: The water is boiling behind the rear guard! Mordred is calling drowned things up from the deep!

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Eyes forward and backs to the pillars! Nobody goes into that black water alive!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Mordred's ward is failing. Cut him down on his own altar.

ambient_barks: Cold black water laps stone causeways.
Chanting echoes off vaulted wet ceilings.
Watch your footing on slick moss!
Drowned hands claw up the bridge.
Incense and copper choke the air.
Steel rings dull in the damp.
Protect the casters from behind!
Blood hisses on ancient altar stone.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: Mordred is ash at last, yet his ledger speaks of a mistress beyond the border—one who bankrolled every raider banner.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: The northern road is open for supply wagons again, though my boots will never dry.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Burn his altar notes. Leave nothing for the next zealot.

m04-the-sunken-sanctum.defeat_line: Dragged into sunless water by armored hands, your company joins the silent congregation beneath Ravenwatch.

optional_choice.prompt: Mordred's blood-stained grimoire lies open beside a vessel of consecrated silver.
optional_choice.a: Seize the grimoire for Marta to decode the coven's network.
optional_choice.b: Drown the book in consecrated silver to purge its lingering curse.
optional_choice.effect_a: Unlock +15% shadow resistance for casters; a vengeful assassin ambushes your camp in Act II (m19).
optional_choice.effect_b: Gain +200 gold in purified silver and cleanse party fatigue; lose clues on Mordred's patron.

m04-the-sunken-sanctum.codex_note: The Sunken Sanctum predates human settlement in the Border Fords. Its submerged colonnades align with no known imperial compass, pointing instead toward the volcanic south.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: No moon reaches the floor of Lantern Passage; dead pine trunks tangle across the ravine like broken ribs.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Courier Corin carries sealed dispatches from the high passes. The Ravine Warden has him pinned under cliff-side bowmen.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
intro_scene.line: Smugglers call this cut Night Cargo—anything dropped in the dark belongs to whoever survives until morning.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: We breach the upper barricades, pull Corin out, and get him to the northeast beacon before his blood runs dry.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Douse extra torches until we reach the first cliff ladder.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Ambush from the deadfalls! Clear the lower barricade before their bowmen find our range!

milestones.speaker: field-courier-corin
milestones.line: Over here—behind the overturned wagon! The seals are intact, though my leg's pinned!

milestones.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
milestones.line: Lanterns bobbing on the ridge—more Night Cargo cutthroats closing the gorge behind us!

milestones.speaker: field-courier-corin
milestones.line: The northeast beacon is fifty paces! Hold them off the steps!

ambient_barks: Bowstrings twang from unseen cliff ledges.
Boots crunch over dry pine needles.
Keep low beneath the deadfall!
A signal whistle pierces the ravine.
Sparks fly off stone arrowheads.
Someone groans beneath a splintered cart.
Light the beacon—now!
Rocks clatter down the gorge wall.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-courier-corin
victory_epilogue.line: Blood on the wax, but the imperial seal holds. The high passes aren't facing raids—they're facing a coordinated rising.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: Without these letters, Thornwick would have marched straight into a meat-grinder.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Get Corin a horse and a healer. We strike their supplies next.

m05-lantern-passage.defeat_line: In the moonless gorge, cold steel finds the courier's throat and leaves Thornwick deaf to the storm ahead.

optional_choice.prompt: A sealed diplomatic pouch marked 'Private — Provincial Governor' spills from a dead outrider's saddlebag.
optional_choice.a: Break the wax and read the governor's secret correspondence.
optional_choice.b: Hand the pouch unopened to Garrick for official dispatch.
optional_choice.effect_a: Discover the governor bribed border clans (+20% gold loot in Act I); Garrick distrusts you (-10 loyalty).
optional_choice.effect_b: Gain +100 gold official commendation; the governor's agent sabotages a supply wagon in Act II (m17).

m05-lantern-passage.codex_note: Lantern Passage earned its name from the iron signal braziers bolted into its sheer limestone walls, once lit to guide winter mail riders through fog-choked canyons.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Under Greywood's needle-thick canopy, noon looks like dusk and every hollow smells of tallow and brine.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: Quartermaster Tarn is hoarding stolen imperial iron and black powder in three timber caches. Burn them before winter sets in.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Watch for The Quartermaster's Ledger when his command tent burns—names of every turncoat merchant will be inked inside.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Strike fast, torch the powder last, and get clear before the blast brings the pines down on our heads.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Spread oil on the salted meat first. Powder goes up as we leave.

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: Tarn's pikemen wear good Thornwick steel! Hit their flanks before they form a hedge!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: Two warehouses blazing! Keep fire away from the black powder kegs until our men clear the ditch!

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Smoke's choking the vanguard—push through the clearing or we cook in our own armor!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: There is Tarn by the command wagon. Take his head and The Quartermaster's Ledger.

ambient_barks: Tar barrels hiss and split open.
Black powder smoke stings the eyes.
Save the iron ingots, burn the grain!
Pine needles rain sparks onto cloaks.
Tarn barks orders from his wagon.
Casks of salted pork burst in flame.
Clear the ditch before the powder blows!
Heavy boots pound the mossy trail.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
victory_epilogue.line: Three depots in cinders and good iron back in honest hands. Their warbands will be chewing boot leather by Frostfall.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: Scorched edges, legible ink—this ledger names buyers as far south as the Redmarsh border.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Let them starve. We march for the high crags at dawn.

m06-greywood-supply.defeat_line: Trapped in burning thickets beneath a hail of poisoned barbs, your company feeds the Greywood soil.
m06-greywood-supply.codex_note: Greywood's ancient spruce stands were once reserved strictly for royal shipbuilding; since the border wars, its tangled ravines have sheltered deserters and illicit foundries.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: A razor-backed granite horn splits the alpine road into two cold gorges where shadows never thaw.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Runic monoliths—woken by earth sorcery—block both defiles. Neither stone sentinel will fall unless both cairns are lit together.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Dividing our strength in a mountain pass violates every rule I was taught. Half the men on each side, and pray neither falters.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: Pack heavy mauls on both wings—swords will only chip your wrists against basalt.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Two columns. Light both cairns on the same horn blast.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Stone fists are moving! Keep heavy armor in front and hammer at their knee-joints!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: The Northern Cairn catches! Push the southern column—the leyline won't hold half-lit!

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: Blades bounce off granite hide! Use mauls and lightning—anything that cracks stone!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Sound the horn. Kindle the second cairn now.

ambient_barks: Grinding granite echoes between twin cliffs.
Boulders crash down the scree slope.
Ley-fire hums inside ancient cairn stones.
Swords spark uselessly off basalt armor.
Hold the eastern gorge—help is coming!
Thin mountain air burns tired lungs.
Crack the runes along its spine!
Golden fire leaps between the peaks.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: The warding leylines hum steady again. Whoever woke those sentinels did not build them—they merely twisted an older lock.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: Both wings intact and the supply road clear. Remind me never to split a column twice in one campaign.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Keep moving while the pass is warm.

m07-split-vanguard.defeat_line: Divided by a wall of indifferent granite, both halves of your vanguard are ground to paste beneath living stone.
m07-split-vanguard.codex_note: The Twin Cairns of Craghorn were raised by pre-imperial surveyors to anchor weather-wards across the alpine watershed. When both burn gold, mountain storms part around the pass.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Hundreds of farm carts choke the western road while warhorns boom across the swollen Alder.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
intro_scene.line: Three thousand folk from the river parishes are still on the mud track. If Alder Bridge falls, they drown or bleed.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Archers on the chalk bluff, pikes locked across the timber span. Three waves are forming on the east bank—not one boot crosses.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: Oak pilings are damp from the spring thaw; they won't burn fast, so hold the deck with iron.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Plant the stakes. Hold the bridge until the last cart clears the hill.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: First wave on the timbers! Pikes level—let them impale themselves on their own rush!

milestones.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
milestones.line: Another banner pouring out of the alder scrub! They're bringing heavy shields for the second push!

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: The bridge planks are slick with gore! Step over the dead and plug that gap!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Last wave. The refugees are over the crest—break them here.

ambient_barks: Timber bridge arches groan under boots.
Volleys whistle down from the bluff.
Refugee wheels creak in the distance.
Pikes splinter against iron-rimmed shields.
Bodies splash into the Alder rapids.
Hold the western abutment!
Warhorns blare from the eastern bank.
Stand fast—not one step back!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
victory_epilogue.line: Every cart made the ridge road. Half the valley owes its breath to the timber you held today.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: We'll need axes to clear the bridge planks before wagons can roll again, but the line held.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Bury our dead on the west bank. Then we hunt their chief.

m08-alder-bridge.defeat_line: The bridgehead buckles beneath a howling tide, and the western road turns into a slaughterhouse of overturned carts.

optional_choice.prompt: A merchant guild wagon loaded with siege oil blocks the narrow bridge approach behind your pikemen.
optional_choice.a: Dump the oil onto the bridge deck and ignite it to stall the third wave.
optional_choice.b: Have your reserves haul the wagon to safety to preserve the guild's cargo.
optional_choice.effect_a: Weaken Wave 3 enemies by 30%, but fire damages the span (-75 gold repair levy in Thornwick).
optional_choice.effect_b: Gain +150 gold guild reward after battle; Wave 3 hits your front line at full strength.

m08-alder-bridge.codex_note: Built on oak pilings driven deep into the river gravel, Alder Bridge is the sole crossing wide enough for wheeled artillery between Thornwick and the high moors.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Peat fog hangs low over the abandoned granite quarry where Krag Ironhide's war-drum beats like a slow heart.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: I've seen that brute take a broadhead to the ribs and snap the shaft like dry reed. His hide is baked with quarry-sorcery.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Lightning and heavy mauls will crack his carapace. Also keep an eye out for Glass in the Thicket—vitrified slag from the old kilns.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Peel his escort off in the bog first. Get Krag alone before dusk or he rallies every broken clan in the hills.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Draw his bodyguard into the mire. Save lightning for the big one.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Skirmishers in the heather! Cut his outriders down before they close around him!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: There—glinting beneath the gorse! Glass in the Thicket, fused by whatever magic hardened Krag's skin!

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: His maul just caved in three shields at once! Keep moving—do not stand square to his swing!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: His carapace is fissured. Put everything into that crack.

ambient_barks: Krag's stone maul shakes the peat.
Arcane sparks dance across granite skin.
Watch the sinkholes along the quarry!
Chipped stone flakes off his shoulders.
Moorland horns wail in ragged retreat.
Sledgehammers ring against living rock.
He's limping—press the flank!
Dusk purple settles over the quarry.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
victory_epilogue.line: Look at him—crumbled like an old millstone. Without Krag, the moorland clans won't muster ten spears.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: The rune branded beneath his breastplate matches Mordred's sanctum. Someone is forging living weapons.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Take the rune-rubbing. Ashbrook is running out of time.

m09-ironhide-hunt.defeat_line: Krag's stone maul drives your frontline into the black peat, leaving the northern clans united beneath a living colossus.
m09-ironhide-hunt.codex_note: Once worked by imperial stonemasons for Thornwick's curtain wall, the Granite Quarry was abandoned after miners uncovered vitrified veins that dulled tempered chisels.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Cold air breathes up from the Undervault Links, carrying the stench of stale incense and wet iron.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: Three dwarven galleries cut straight beneath the ridge to Ashbrook. Better than starving on the snow-choked pass above.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Blood cultists have nested in the old guardrooms and twisted the stone guardians. Keep torches close—darkness feeds their wards.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Single file at the sluice-gates, wide shield-wall in the vaults.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Clear gallery by gallery. Leave no side-tunnel unchecked behind us.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: Cultists in the first arch! Strike their chant-leaders before they wake the wall-sentinels!

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: Dwarven sluice-gates ahead—two galleries purged, one to go!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: Torches guttering! Shadow-wards are draining the oil—press forward into the light-shaft!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: The Ashbrook stair is right behind that altar. Break them.

ambient_barks: Footsteps echo endlessly down vaulted stone.
Chisel-work runes glow dull crimson.
Torchlight flickers against damp basalt.
Cultist daggers rasp from leather sheaths.
Water drips steadily into stagnant cisterns.
Watch the alcoves on both flanks!
Corrupted stone joints grind in darkness.
Fresh mountain air drafts from ahead.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
victory_epilogue.line: Clean dwarven stonework from end to end. Supply mules can march under the peaks without losing a single pack.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: I can already hear siege engines hammering above us. Ashbrook's south gate is taking a beating.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Rest ten minutes, check your straps, and climb.

m10-undervault-links.defeat_line: Swallowed by pitch-black galleries miles beneath the granite ridge, your expedition vanishes without a marker.

optional_choice.prompt: A sealed dwarven armory vault stands ajar in the second gallery, guarded by a dormant rune-lock.
optional_choice.a: Spend time and arcane charge forcing the dwarven vault open.
optional_choice.b: Bypass the vault to reach Ashbrook's besieged gate before nightfall.
optional_choice.effect_a: Gain Masterwork Dwarven Plate (+2 armor), but Ashbrook's outer gate starts m11 at 70% integrity.
optional_choice.effect_b: Arrive early at Ashbrook (+15% defender morale in m11), leaving the vault's relics behind.

m10-undervault-links.codex_note: Carved by exiled smith-clans during the First Compact, the Undervault Links connect the border valleys through three miles of ventilated stone galleries.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Ashbrook's southern gatehouse shudders under iron-shod rams while pale ash drifts down from a bruised sky.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
intro_scene.line: Half the garrison is out of quarrels and three hundred townsfolk are packed behind the inner bar! Hold the gate!

intro_scene.speaker: morvessa
intro_scene.line: Look how tightly they huddle behind cracked mortar. Vaelen—break their hinges and salt the cellar.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: That voice on the wind... Morvessa. She's the hand behind Mordred, Krag, all of it—watching from the ridge!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
intro_scene.line: The gate timbers won't survive another hour of rams. We hold the breach, then sally up the road and kill Vaelen!

intro_scene.speaker: morvessa
intro_scene.line: Run south into the red dust if you survive, little captain. The desert is already dug for your bones.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
intro_scene.line: Wagons are hitched at the north postern, captain. Just buy us twenty minutes.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Form on the gatehouse steps. Nobody dies behind a locked door today.

milestones.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
milestones.line: The postern splintered! Plug the gap with steel until the townsfolk clear the inner ward!

milestones.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
milestones.line: Arrows spent! Draw cleavers and hammers—make them pay three lives for every yard!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: The evacuees are clear. Open the sally port—we take Vaelen's head on the road.

milestones.speaker: morvessa
milestones.line: A stubborn spark in the ash. Let us see if you survive the Redmarsh sun.

ambient_barks: Iron rams boom against oak gates.
Refugees hurry through smoke-choked alleys.
Hold the breach for Thornvael!
Boiling pitch hisses off siege shields.
Vaelen's warhorn splits the valley.
Morvessa's laughter rides the cold wind.
Sally out—cut down their bannermen!
Ash settles thick over bloody cobbles.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
victory_epilogue.line: Vaelen's dead in the mud and the southern road is open. Ashbrook is a shell, but its people live.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: Morvessa slipped south before our blades could reach the ridge. Every trail leads into the Redmarsh now.

victory_epilogue.speaker: morvessa
victory_epilogue.line: Follow the red dust, then. You will find what wakes beneath the salt.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
victory_epilogue.line: We'll forge new gates when this war is buried. For now, point us south.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Burn what we cannot carry. Tomorrow we cross the boundary stone.

m11-ashbrook-retreat.defeat_line: Ashbrook's gates collapse in a roar of splintered oak, and Morvessa's host turns the border town into smoking rubble.

optional_choice.prompt: Ashbrook's treasury vault and the town's wounded militia both require wagons before the final withdrawal.
optional_choice.a: Load the wounded militia onto the remaining draft wagons.
optional_choice.b: Load the provincial gold chests onto the wagons instead.
optional_choice.effect_a: Start Act II (m12) with +25% reserve manpower and high morale, but only 50 gold.
optional_choice.effect_b: Start Act II (m12) with +350 gold, but wounded veterans perish (-15% morale in Act II).

m11-ashbrook-retreat.codex_note: Gateway between the wooded Border Fords and the alkali wastes of Redmarsh, Ashbrook stood for four centuries as the southern hinge of the imperial frontier.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Beyond the boundary obelisk, green pine gives way to rust-red salt pans and ribs of bleached cattle.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Three supply trains vanished between here and the salt flats. No causeway, no campaign—we starve in a week.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Drink slowly, northerners. This red brine blisters the tongue and draws giant scourges when blood hits the mud.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: The border outposts were rebuilt atop old bone-pits. Clear them fast before the midday heat cooks men inside their mail.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take the causeway. Keep water skins covered.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-seti-notary
intro_scene.line: Tomb-Notary Seti tilts his brass spectacles at Morvessa's Signet Ring on your hand with cautious respect: 'A southern High Auditor's stamp. Keep that seal dry—in Redmarsh, even the dead owe probate.'

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Raiders rising out of the salt ditches! Hold the stone causeway—don't get bogged in the crust!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: Chitin clicking under the silt! Giant vermin smell fresh blood—watch your ankles!

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Sun's blinding off the salt! Rotate the front rank before heatstroke drops them!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: One outpost left. Break their palisade and plant our banner.

ambient_barks: Salt crust crunches beneath iron boots.
Heat shimmer distorts the distant horizon.
Chitinous claws click in stagnant brine.
Ration your water—noon is coming!
Red dust cakes sweat onto mail.
Desert raiders whistle like dry wind.
Keep off the soft alkali sinks!
Bleached ribs jut from rust silt.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: Causeway secured and markers planted. My supply mules can finally cross without sinking to their bellies.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: These outposts weren't built to stop an army—they were built to guard something moving north from the deep basin.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Dig wells and post sentries. We push inland at dusk.

m12-redmarsh-border.defeat_line: Baked inside blistering armor and dragged into alkaline mire, your expedition leaves only white bones for the Redmarsh.
m12-redmarsh-border.codex_note: The Redmarsh is the dried bed of an ancient inland sea whose iron-rich silt stains boots, banners, and wounds a permanent rust crimson.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: A sheer wall of red granite splits the basin, pierced only by two wind-scoured notches bristling with stakes.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Composite bowmen in high stone blinds cover both the West and East Passes. Marching straight at the spikes is suicide.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Take the ridge trails first. When you secure the crest, check their watch-logs—The Canyon Audit will tell us who arms these clans.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: I know goat-tracks up both flanks, commander—steep, but out of their arrow-slits.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Clear the high blinds first. Storm the barricades once their arrows stop.

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Plunging fire from the cliff blinds! Keep shields overhead till the flankers climb!

milestones.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
milestones.line: West blind taken! Look at the iron tallies carved into the lintel—The Canyon Audit begins right here.

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Boulders rolling down the East notch! Hug the inner cliff face!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Both ridges are ours. Drop down and shatter the central gates.

milestones.speaker: field-ravenwatch-deserter
milestones.line: That surviving northern deserter from Ravenwatch Keep just dropped a knotted climbing rope down the central rock chimney—our flankers are climbing straight into the sniper blinds!

ambient_barks: Composite arrows punch deep into shields.
Loose scree clatters down granite walls.
Hot wind howls through narrow notches.
Clear the high blinds first!
Spiked barricades block the wagon track.
Iron-tipped spears glint in stone slots.
Keep your shield-wall angled upward!
Dust plumes rise across the basin.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: Imperial sentinels hold the crest now. Every dust cloud for twenty miles is ours to read.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: The tallies confirm it: iron ingots from the Deep Quarry are paying for every bow in these passes.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Leave a picket on the ridge. Move down into the basin.

m13-twin-passes.defeat_line: Pinned against blistering granite beneath plunging shafts and rolling boulders, your company breaks in a bloody rout.
m13-twin-passes.codex_note: Known locally as the Jawbones, the Twin Passes control the sole caravan route across the Redmarsh escarpment; whoever holds the blinds taxes every drop of water moving north.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: A copper dust storm scours Bracken Basin while three distant signal flares gutter out in the scrub.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: Three vanguard squads got cut off among the sandstone boulders when the storm hit. They're down to their last quivers.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Sand-clans hunt in rings during a haboob—they bleed a pocket dry, then move to the next. Ride hard or find corpses.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Lose those scouts and we cross the northern crags without a single pair of eyes.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Nearest ring first. Keep horns sounding so they hear us through the grit.

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: First squad spotted behind the red boulders! Break the outer ring before they rush!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: Two squads pulled clear—one left in the deep scrub, and the storm's thickening!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Dust riders circling back from the dunes! They're trying to cut off our extraction lane!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: All three squads are on our line. Crush the encirclement.

ambient_barks: Blowing sand stings eyes and nostrils.
Distant horn blasts fade in wind.
Hold the sandstone ring—help's here!
War-cries echo out of copper haze.
Empty quivers rattle against leather boots.
Sound the rally horn again!
Blood dries instantly on sun-baked rock.
Cut through the rider cordon!

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: Every scout accounted for, battered but breathing. They saw clans excavating giant quartz monoliths across the northern crags.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: The ancient climate wardstones... if they crack those seals, the Redmarsh will swallow half the borderlands.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Get the wounded water. We march for the plateau.

m14-scattered-scouts.defeat_line: You reach the sandstone rings only to find silent bodies impaled on cactus poles beneath a pitiless copper sky.

optional_choice.prompt: One rescued scout squad begs to detour to recover their dead sergeant's cipher-satchel in a dune hollow.
optional_choice.a: Detour into the storm to retrieve the cipher-satchel.
optional_choice.b: Order an immediate withdrawal while the storm covers your tracks.
optional_choice.effect_a: Gain enemy patrol routes (+10% ambush defense in Act II), but storm exposure drains 15% unit stamina.
optional_choice.effect_b: Preserve full squad stamina and water rations, but lose the sergeant's reconnaissance notes.

m14-scattered-scouts.codex_note: Bracken Basin is a labyrinth of wind-carved hoodoos and thorny scrub where seasonal dust storms can erase landmarks and swallow entire patrols within minutes.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Twilight bleeds purple over Highgate Watch, where sun-cracked pine logs groan against desert gusts.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Three warbands are creeping up the dry creek beds with scaling ladders and clay firepots. One spark and this dry timber goes up like straw.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Keep sand buckets beside every catwalk. Water's too precious to waste on firepots unless the gate itself catches.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: If Highgate burns, every road back to the Twin Passes lies wide open behind us.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Archers on the walkways. Shock troops sally out to smash the ladder teams.

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Ladders clattering against the east wall! Kill the firepot throwers before they hurl!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Second warband emerging from the north creek bed—torches lit!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: Timber's smoking on the south corner! Smother it with sand—hold till grey dawn!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Dawn's breaking on the ridge. Drive them back into the creek beds.

ambient_barks: Clay firepots shatter against dry logs.
Scaling ladders thud onto timber parapets.
Throw sand on the flames!
Night arrows hiss across dry creek beds.
Charred pine crackles in hot wind.
Push the ladders off the wall!
Stars pale toward grey desert dawn.
Hold Highgate Watch till sunrise!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: Scorched black and stinking of pitch, but Highgate Watch still stands. Dawn caught hundreds of them in the ditch.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: They threw everything they had at a wooden fence and broke their teeth on it.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Patch the wall and douse the embers. Next we save the wardstones.

m15-outpost-palisade.defeat_line: Pitch-soaked firepots turn Highgate Watch into a funeral pyre, lighting the night sky for twenty leagues.
m15-outpost-palisade.codex_note: Haphazardly built from salvaged siege timbers, Highgate Watch anchors the northern rim of the Redmarsh where dry arroyos funnel desert raiders toward the highland passes.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Three colossal quartz spires jut from the plateau like broken teeth, weeping black blood into howling grit.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Those wardstones anchor our climate wards. Blood sorcerers are cracking them—and taking Rubbings in Blood from the runes!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: If all three rupture together, the resulting sandstorm will strip flesh from bone across three provinces.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Wrap wet cloth over your faces—that quartz dust turns lungs to wet cement.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Slay the ward-breakers at each circle. Re-attune the quartz before the fissures widen.

milestones.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
milestones.line: First ritual circle ahead! Kill the blood-chanters before the quartz fissure splits!

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: Two spires humming azure again—look at the altar parchment, Rubbings in Blood! Take them when we clear the third!

milestones.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
milestones.line: Static is burning our skin! The third stone is howling—hurry!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Strike the last ward-breaker. Seal the stone.

ambient_barks: Cracked quartz hums at teeth-rattling pitch.
Toxic grit blisters exposed wrists.
Azure light wars with crimson blood-wards.
Chanting rises above the howling squall.
Static sparks leap from iron helms.
Seal the fissure—the stone is splitting!
Sand whips like razor wire.
A deep chime echoes across plateau.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: Pure azure resonance again—and the squalls are dying. These Rubbings in Blood copy a locking sigil older than the Empire.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: They weren't trying to destroy the plateau. They were testing how to crack a much larger seal further south.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Keep those rubbings dry. Bram's supply convoy needs us on the causeway.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: Every harmonic interval of the quartz wardstones is copied into my ledger. If Oakhaven's cliff-wards falter, Ward-Scholar Elowen will need these notes.

m16-wardstone-rupture.defeat_line: The three quartz monoliths detonate in a wall of boiling sand and arcane fire, erasing your army in a single blinding breath.

optional_choice.prompt: A captive blood-acolyte offers to stabilize the third wardstone instantly in exchange for his freedom.
optional_choice.a: Accept his ritual aid to spare your troops from arcane backlash.
optional_choice.b: Execute him and force Zahra to re-attune the monolith manually.
optional_choice.effect_a: Finish battle with full unit health, but the freed acolyte warns Hexer Kaelen (+15% caster armor in m19).
optional_choice.effect_b: Units suffer 15% arcane burn damage, but Kaelen's coven remains unaware of your approach.

m16-wardstone-rupture.codex_note: Carved from single pillars of primeval quartz, the Plateau Wardstones were raised by forgotten geomancers to anchor rain-clouds and keep the Redmarsh alkali from drifting north.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Iron-rimmed wagon wheels sink axle-deep in red mud while dragonflies the size of hawks circle overhead.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Every bandage, arrow, and barrel of clean water for the forward camp rides in these six wagons. Lose them and the campaign stops dead.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Don't drink from The Bitter Well by the third milestone—the clans poisoned it with beetle-bile to drop thirsty escorts.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: Mudbanks on both sides are pocked with burrow-holes. Keep pikes outboard.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Screen both mudbanks. Nobody breaks formation to chase stragglers.

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Dune scourges erupting from the mudbanks! Keep them off the draft horses!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: We're passing The Bitter Well—keep men away from the trough and watch the reeds behind it!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Giant marsh beetles surfacing behind the rear wagon! Spears to the back!

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Forward camp palisade in sight! Drive the teams through the mud!

ambient_barks: Wagon axles groan in thick red mire.
Whip-cracks urge exhausted mules forward.
Giant beetles hiss from sunken reeds.
Guard the powder wagon—keep sparks away!
Mud splatters across visors and shields.
Poisoned water steams in stone troughs.
Keep pace with the lead team!
Chitin cracks under heavy halberds.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: Six wagons, six intact axles, and not a single crate lost to the mud. The forward camp can actually fight tomorrow.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
victory_epilogue.line: Clean water and fresh steel—worth more than crowns out here.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Unload the powder. Tonight we hit their granary.

m17-mire-convoy.defeat_line: Overturned and burning in the alkali mud, Bram's wagons leave the forward army starving for steel, medicine, and water.

optional_choice.prompt: One wagon's axle snaps in deep mire while giant beetles close on the rear guard.
optional_choice.a: Halt the column under fire to salvage the medical crates onto spare mules.
optional_choice.b: Cut the wagon loose and burn it to keep the convoy moving.
optional_choice.effect_a: Keep +25% post-battle healing for Act II, but lose 20% frontline health fighting off the swarm.
optional_choice.effect_b: Escape cleanly with zero casualties, but lose medical reserves (-15% healing until m21).

m17-mire-convoy.codex_note: The Sunken Causeway crosses the lowest salt-pan of the Redmarsh atop sunken timber cribs that shift after every flash flood.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Inside a blind sandstone box canyon, stolen imperial grain sacks are stacked three stories high beneath tarred canvas.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Their main warbands are riding east. We breach the trench, burn their stores, and haul back the gold they looted from border farms.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Watch the curing sheds—Granary Smokers burn dried desert thorn that blinds a man faster than pepper.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: One narrow mouth in and out—if we linger past sundown, their riders bottle us up inside.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Fast breach. Grab the coin chests before you light the grain.

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Trench guards alerted! Cross the ditch before they light the thorn-smokers!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: Coughing wind from the curing sheds—Granary Smokers! Stay upwind of the grey smoke!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Outriders spotted on the canyon rim! Move faster before they seal the mouth!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Gold is loaded. Torch the granaries and clear the canyon.

ambient_barks: Bitter thorn-smoke stings watering eyes.
Grain sacks split, spilling golden wheat.
Chest locks shatter under iron crowbars.
Flames roar up tarred canvas roofs.
Horns echo down sandstone canyon walls.
Haul the coin chests—move!
Trench stakes splinter beneath heavy boots.
Heat blasts out from burning storehouses.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: Cinders for their warbands, bread for the refugee camps, and heavy coin for our war chest.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
victory_epilogue.line: Nothing makes a raider turn homeward faster than an empty belly.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Get out of the canyon before their riders regroup.

m18-granary-raid.defeat_line: Bogged down in the outer trenches until enemy riders seal the canyon mouth, your strike force is butchered between red walls.

optional_choice.prompt: Flames threaten a locked vault holding either imperial tax bullion or crates of rare desert star-metal.
optional_choice.a: Break open the tax bullion vault before the roof collapses.
optional_choice.b: Haul out the heavy crates of raw star-metal instead.
optional_choice.effect_a: Gain +250 gold immediately for troop hiring and supplies.
optional_choice.effect_b: Unlock Forgemaster Vok's star-metal weapon upgrade in Act III (m26) (+2 weapon damage).

m18-granary-raid.codex_note: Hidden behind a wind-eroded slot canyon, Redrock Box was once an imperial silver assay post before desert marauders converted its vaulted cellars into a siege depot.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Twelve black standing stones ring a hollow where green miasma pools like stagnant oil around kneeling acolytes.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
intro_scene.line: Hexer Kaelen is rotting our wounded from twenty miles away—marrow turning to grey pulp inside clean bandages.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: His perimeter wards feed on fear and breath. Step through the gaps between the stones and cut Kaelen down before the chant peaks.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Half my best sergeants are spitting grey phlegm in the hospital tents. End him.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Breathe through wet cloth. Straight for the center ring.

milestones.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
milestones.line: Perimeter wards triggered! Do not linger in the green mist—keep pushing inward!

milestones.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
milestones.line: His curse is pulling at old scars! Focus on Kaelen—his concentration is the only thing holding this ring!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Hollow-eyed thralls rising from the bone-trenches behind us!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Kaelen is exposed. Break his staff and end the plague.

ambient_barks: Sweet rot hangs thick in still air.
Megalithic runes pulse sickly bile-green.
Wet cloth muffles ragged coughing.
Necrotic mist corrodes polished mail.
Kaelen's chanting rasps like dry bone.
Smash the ritual censers!
Old wounds throb inside the stone ring.
Cold sweat beads under iron helms.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
victory_epilogue.line: The green fog is lifting—and word from camp says the fever in the hospital tents broke the moment Kaelen fell.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: He wore a ring stamped with Gorrathul's iron crown. The warlord at the Fork of Spears is using necromancers as artillery.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Topple the standing stones. Leave no altar intact.

m19-hexer-capture.defeat_line: Choked by vile miasma and withered from within, your company collapses before the silent ring of black megaliths.
m19-hexer-capture.codex_note: The Megalithic Hollow predates human memory in the Redmarsh; nomadic herders shun the ring even in drought, claiming grass that grows inside its shadow turns teeth black.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Switchback ramps spiral down into a smoking pit where chained miners chip black ironstone under whip-cracks.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Every blade and siege-ram Gorrathul fields is forged from the black ironstone hauled out of this pit.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Watch the lower vats—they seal their funerary urns and firepots with Canopic Tar boiled from the quarry's deep seams.

intro_scene.speaker: field-miner-tomas
intro_scene.line: Break the slave-pens on the third terrace and we'll bury our overseers with our own picks!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take the ballista ledges first. Fight downward terrace by terrace.

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Quarry ballistas aiming up the ramp! Take cover behind the ore carts and rush the crew!

milestones.speaker: field-miner-tomas
milestones.line: Pen gates shattered! Grab picks, lads—pay them back for every winter in the dark!

milestones.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
milestones.line: Boiling Canopic Tar tipping from the crane-buckets! Clear the lower terrace!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Chief overseer on the pit floor. Drop him and cut the chains.

ambient_barks: Iron picks ring against black ore.
Heavy ballista bolts splinter ore carts.
Shackles rattle as freed miners charge.
Black tar bubbles in iron cauldrons.
Overseer whips crack above the pit.
Sledgehammers crush ironclad helmets!
Coal dust chokes the lower terraces.
Cut the crane ropes—drop the hoist!

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-miner-tomas
victory_epilogue.line: Three hundred men breathing free air again—and half of us swing a hammer better than your recruits swing a sword.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: With the hoists burned and the pit flooded, Gorrathul's forges won't see another ounce of black ironstone.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Arm the miners who want to fight. Send the rest north to Thornwick.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-gorin-miner
victory_epilogue.line: Miner Gorin raises a heavy black-ironstone hammer: 'Our chains are broken, commander. My smiths are marching to the coast to plate the hulls of Oakhaven's evacuation ships!'

m20-deep-quarry.defeat_line: Pinned on the upper switchbacks by quarry ballistas, your company is cut down above the chains of the captives you came to free.

optional_choice.prompt: Freed quarry miners ask to either join your assault on Ironheart Bastion or escort the weakest captives north.
optional_choice.a: Draft the strongest miners as heavy pioneer auxiliaries for the final push.
optional_choice.b: Send all freed miners north to reinforce Thornwick's reconstruction.
optional_choice.effect_a: Gain +2 Heavy Pioneer squads for m21–m23, but 15% of weak captives perish on the unguarded road.
optional_choice.effect_b: All captives reach safety (+150 gold crown reward in Act III), with no extra auxiliaries now.

m20-deep-quarry.codex_note: Sunk four hundred feet into a volcanic fault, the Deep Quarry yields dense black ironstone prized for siege armor and cursed runesmithing alike.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Wind whistles through half-built stone revetments at Crossroads Redoubt, where forty tired sentinels guard four empty roads.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: Our main column is ten miles east. Enemy scouts spotted how thin we are here and threw three vanguard packs straight at the junction.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: If they take Crossroads Redoubt, they cut our supply line and trap the east wing between two armies.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Two cisterns inside the wall—enough water for three days if we keep their torches off the roof.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Hold the stone revetments. Conserve spells until they hit the inner ditch.

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Outnumbered three to one—make every arrow count before they reach the low wall!

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Second column swinging in from the south track! Shift spears to the right revetment!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Half the line bleeding and no relief till dusk! Dig your heels in!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Their vanguard chief is down. Hold thirty more breaths and they break.

ambient_barks: Thin shield-walls groan under heavy impact.
Save your mana for the breach!
Stones clatter from half-mortared parapets.
Four roads meet in bloody dust.
Bandaged sentinels limp back to line.
Hold the junction—the army depends on it!
Spear-shafts snap in close quarters.
Enemy horns sound a ragged recall.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: Forty sentinels held an army's lifeline. Not a single raider banner made it past the milestone.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: The east column just linked back up. Our supply road to the Fork of Spears is intact.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Relieve the sentinels and give them double rations. We ride at dawn.

m21-lean-garrison.defeat_line: The thin sentinel line buckles at the crossroads, slicing your campaign in half across the open desert.
m21-lean-garrison.codex_note: Marked by a four-faced milestone carved with imperial distances, Crossroads Redoubt is the sole fortified well-station controlling movement across the central Redmarsh.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Gale-force wind howls through Spearwind Gorge, whipping red sand off razor-edged limestone fins.

intro_scene.speaker: field-warden-hale
intro_scene.line: Commander Vorn is sprinting up the gorge with Gorrathul's battle maps. If he reaches the gates, Ironheart doubles its watch.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Look at the trail behind his riders—Empty Waterskins tossed in the gravel. He's driving his horses to death to beat us.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Those maps show every blind spot in Ironheart's curtain wall. Do not let them vanish behind that portcullis.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Light armor forward. Cut his rear guard and bring Vorn down before the gate.

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Rear guard turning to stall us! Punch through—don't get bogged down in a duel!

milestones.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
milestones.line: More Empty Waterskins and a foundered warhorse—we're gaining on Vorn's banner!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Crossbowmen dropping from the gorge ledges to cover Vorn's sprint!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Three hundred yards to the portcullis. Drop Vorn now.

ambient_barks: Gale winds howl through narrow stone.
Hooves clatter wildly over loose shale.
Empty waterskins tumble across red gravel.
Do not let Vorn reach the gate!
Crossbow bolts ricochet off canyon walls.
Horses scream as they founder on stone.
Sprint—ignore the stragglers behind us!
The iron portcullis groans upward ahead.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: Vorn's dead twenty paces short of the chains—and the map case was still strapped to his ribs.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: Look at the eastern culvert on his blueprint: an unguarded drainage sluice beneath Ironheart's curtain wall.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: That sluice just saved five hundred lives. Muster the whole army.

m22-fleeing-column.defeat_line: Vorn slips beneath the falling iron portcullis, alerting Ironheart Bastion and turning your assault into a bloodbath.

optional_choice.prompt: Vorn's dying second-in-command offers the Bastion's garrison rotation schedule if spared.
optional_choice.a: Spare the officer and extract the guard rotation schedule.
optional_choice.b: Execute him on the spot so no survivor can warn the gatehouse.
optional_choice.effect_a: Delay enemy reinforcements by 90 seconds in m23, but the prisoner escapes and warns Act III coastal forts (m25).
optional_choice.effect_b: Maintain complete operational secrecy for Act III, facing standard reinforcement timing in m23.

m22-fleeing-column.codex_note: Carved by millennia of sand-laden gales, Spearwind Gorge acts as a natural wind tunnel leading directly to the fortified approaches of the Fork of Spears.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Ironheart Bastion crowns the forked peak like an anvil of black slag above two narrow causeways.

intro_scene.speaker: gorrathul
intro_scene.line: Come then, northern dogs. Cross the salt-bog or the cannon-walk—either road feeds my smelters.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: West Causeway is sinking mire; East runs under cliffside guns. Break the outer redoubts first or bleed out on the stone.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Gorrathul wears the iron crown forged from Deep Quarry ore—and Morvessa's sea-galleys are already waiting beyond the ridge.

intro_scene.speaker: gorrathul
intro_scene.line: Morvessa promised me the Iron Coast if I break your spine here. I intend to collect.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
intro_scene.line: Last skins of water passed out, commander. Beyond that gate lies salt wind and the sea.

intro_scene.speaker: field-miner-tomas
intro_scene.line: My quarry lads brought iron wedges for that citadel hinge—point us at the gate!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Silence the cliff redoubts. Cross both causeways and breach the gate.

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
milestones.line: Catapults opening up from the East cliff! Rush the outer redoubt before they find our range!

milestones.speaker: field-warden-hale
milestones.line: Outer redoubts silenced! Push across the causeways—watch the bog-holes on the west!

milestones.speaker: gorrathul
milestones.line: Pour boiling slag through the murder-holes! Let them smell their own armor melting!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: The citadel gate is down. Put Gorrathul in the dirt.

ambient_barks: Catapult stones shatter causeway flagstones.
Black iron banners snap in mountain gales.
Slag cauldrons hiss above the gatehouse.
Storm the outer redoubts—silence the guns!
Salt-bog bubbles along the West causeway.
Gorrathul's iron war-horn shakes the peak.
Breach the citadel—the coast lies beyond!
Steel rings across blood-slick basalt.

victory_epilogue.speaker: gorrathul
victory_epilogue.line: You broke the anvil... yet the hammer waits on the Iron Coast. Morvessa... already has the fleet...

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: Thornvael's banner flies over Ironheart Bastion! Look west from the parapet—you can see the grey surf of the Iron Coast!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: The Redmarsh campaign is won, yet Gorrathul's last breath confirms our worst fear: the war moves to the sea.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-warden-hale
victory_epilogue.line: Scouts already spot black sails tacking south toward Oakhaven.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Raise the standard and tend the wounded. Tomorrow we march down to Oakhaven.

m23-fork-of-spears.defeat_line: Shattered by cliffside artillery and counter-charging knights on the narrow causeways, your army breaks on Ironheart's black rocks.

optional_choice.prompt: Gorrathul's siege foundries still hold unstable black-powder charges beneath the Bastion's sea-facing wall.
optional_choice.a: Detonate the charges to blow open a shortcut down to the Iron Coast.
optional_choice.b: Defuse the charges and salvage the powder for your coastal campaign.
optional_choice.effect_a: Start Act III (m24) with +1 day head start against Morvessa's fleet, but trigger rockslides (-10% starting morale).
optional_choice.effect_b: Gain +3 Siege Powder charges for Act III, giving Morvessa's ships time to fortify Oakhaven's harbor.

m23-fork-of-spears.codex_note: Built astride the twin volcanic spires known as the Fork of Spears, Ironheart Bastion commands the sole mountain pass linking the arid Redmarsh interior to the stormy Iron Coast.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Freshly split pine sap and cold salt spray sweep Oakhaven's muddy staging ground as distant tremors shake the timber cliffs.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
intro_scene.line: Raiders choke the northern frontier pass while Captain Bram's watch post buckles. Every hull on Kors's slipways counts—not everyone on the shore will ever board a ship.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: Miner Gorin and his freed quarry smiths from Redmarsh are hammering black-ironstone plates onto our caravels right now. Buy us time at the pass!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
intro_scene.line: Hold—that brass seal on your finger. Morvessa's Signet Ring. So the auditors finally paid their own balance.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Rearm at Toren's Ironwood Armory and march north. We hold the gateway so the fleet can rise.

milestones.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
milestones.line: Siege packs are massing beneath Captain Bram's ridge post!

milestones.speaker: npc-toren-armorer
milestones.line: Eastern ridge redoubt breached—five hundred silver coins recovered from the garrison lockbox!

milestones.speaker: npc-bram-captain
milestones.line: Hold the Northern Post! Don't let Oakhaven's gateway fall!

ambient_barks: Hold the timber pass!
For Oakhaven's slipways!
Keep Bram alive!
Ironstone and pine!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-bram-captain
victory_epilogue.line: Oakhaven's torn standard rises again over the pass! The northern gateway holds.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
victory_epilogue.line: Well fought, Shield of the Departing. Now Ward-Scholar Elowen needs you on the cinder cliffs.

m24-pledge-at-oakhaven.defeat_line: Captain Bram's banner collapses in the pine mud, leaving Oakhaven's shipyards open to the slaughter.
m24-pledge-at-oakhaven.codex_note: Oakhaven's ancient ironwood groves fed the realm's merchant navy for centuries before every surviving axe turned to hammering evacuation caravels.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Choking sulfur vents hiss through cracked black glass along the cliffs overlooking Oakhaven, where three corrupted rune-circles whine with failing earth-wards.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elowen-scholar
intro_scene.line: Chronicler Zahra's Redmarsh notes proved the pattern: three outer cinder-wards are tearing at the bedrock! Unless we break West, North, and East, Oakhaven's cliffs will shear into the sea!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
intro_scene.line: Shatter the outer circles first to strip the Central Altar Warden's shield—watch its sweeping magma arcs!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Douse all three outer circles and crack the Central Altar Warden.

milestones.speaker: npc-elowen-scholar
milestones.line: Western Ward collapsed into dead cinder—four hundred star-silver florins exposed!

milestones.speaker: npc-elowen-scholar
milestones.line: Northern and Eastern Wards extinguished! The Central Altar Warden advances!

ambient_barks: Mind the sulfur fissures!
Break the outer circles!
Cool the magma arcs!
Save the cliff wards!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-elowen-scholar
victory_epilogue.line: The corrupted altar shatters and the cliffside wards hum back to steady blue resonance. Zahra's calculations saved half the coast.

m25-cinder-wards.defeat_line: The coastal cinder-wards detonate, shearing Oakhaven's granite cliffs into the boiling surf.
m25-cinder-wards.codex_note: Linked by deep harmonic ley-lines to the Quartz Plateau of Redmarsh, Oakhaven's cliff-wards were the last seal keeping the western escarpment intact.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Twin palisade camps of renegade southern legions straddle a jagged coastal crag, choking off the highway between Oakhaven and Harborwatch.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-toren-armorer
intro_scene.line: If you rush the ridge head-on, both flanking camps will crush our rear. Cleave the West and East flanks first—then bring heavy polearms and spells to fracture the Northern Commander's War-Golem!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Break both flanks before taking the crest.

milestones.speaker: npc-toren-armorer
milestones.line: Western flank broken—five hundred crowns seized from their payroll coffer!

milestones.speaker: npc-toren-armorer
milestones.line: Both flanks are sundered! The Northern Commander charges down the ridge beside his War-Golem!

ambient_barks: Crack the flanks!
Armor-piercing steel on the golem!
Open the coastal highway!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-toren-armorer
victory_epilogue.line: The War-Golem lies in rubble and the encirclement is broken. Now ride fast—Chief Healer Sera's glade is under attack!

m26-sundered-ranks.defeat_line: Pinched between twin renegade camps, your column is cut to pieces beneath the coastal crag.
m26-sundered-ranks.codex_note: Armed with sea-tempered tower shields from Master-at-Arms Toren's Ironwood Armory, terrified refugees learned to stand shoulder-to-shoulder against imperial war-golems.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Canvas pavilions shelter dozens of burned borderers inside an ironwood glade—among them scarred survivors from Thornwick, including Reeve Marlow and Father Cael.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-sera-healer
intro_scene.line: Three predatory warbands are closing in through the trees! If I take one step back, these people bleed out in the mud. Hold the line, commander—I will not leave them!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Form a 360-degree shield wall around the tents. Nobody touches Sera's wounded.

milestones.speaker: npc-sera-healer
milestones.line: Wave one down the northern wagon ruts—wolf-riders and skirmishers!

milestones.speaker: npc-sera-healer
milestones.line: Western pines—poison-arrow snipers and hexers!

milestones.speaker: npc-sera-healer
milestones.line: East flank—a shock battalion spearheaded by a Stone Golem!

ambient_barks: Hold the perimeter!
Protect the stretchers!
Keep Sera alive!
Shield wall around the tents!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-sera-healer
victory_epilogue.line: All three packs broke against your shields. Every stretcher—and Reeve Marlow and Father Cael beside them—will reach Harborwatch intact.

m27-field-infirmary.defeat_line: The canvas pavilions ignite under raider torches, claiming Chief Healer Sera and the last survivors of Thornwick.
m27-field-infirmary.codex_note: Refusing a guaranteed berth on the western armada, Chief Healer Sera swore she would board no vessel until the last stretcher left the ironwood glade.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Stagnant tide-brine laps across the shattered ramparts of a half-drowned imperial sea-cave fortress barring the subterranean aqueducts to Harborwatch.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hale-sapper
intro_scene.line: Ballistas sweep the main breach and knee-deep brine slows every step. Watch the black pools—submerged hollow-guards erupt without warning before you face the barnacle-crusted Citadel Warden!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Force the western postern, clear the flooded courtyard, and unseal the sea-galleries.

milestones.speaker: npc-hale-sapper
milestones.line: Outer gate garrison broken—eight hundred florins recovered from the siege payroll!

milestones.speaker: npc-hale-sapper
milestones.line: The Citadel Warden drags his undertow greatsword out of the keep!

ambient_barks: Watch the dark water!
Brine slows the line!
Silence the ballistas!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hale-sapper
victory_epilogue.line: The Citadel Warden sinks into the brine. The subterranean sea-galleries straight to Harborwatch's riverlocks stand open!

m28-sunken-citadel.defeat_line: Dragged beneath the black tide-pools by barnacled spearmen, your vanguard vanishes into the Sunless Deeps.
m28-sunken-citadel.codex_note: Carved into tidal basalt long before the First Dynasty, the Sunken Citadel's flooded aqueducts once fed Harborwatch's deep docks.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Panicked hammering echoes through wet stone as high tide surges into the lower tidal vaults where imperial inquisitors locked Gate Warden Lyra, Thornwick craftsmen, and half of Oakhaven's shipwrights.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
intro_scene.line: The hourglass is turned and seawater is already lapping at the cell-grates! Smash every barricade—if these shipwrights drown, Kors will never finish the evacuation hulls in time!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Full speed through the gorge! Break those flooded locks before the tide reaches their chins!

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: Half the sand has fallen—keep pushing north!

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: The timbers are splintering—only moments remain!

ambient_barks: Faster! The tide is rising!
Break the barricades!
Save the shipwrights!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
victory_epilogue.line: Pulled clear with water at their chins! Every freed shipwright is already marching to Master Kors's slipways at Harborwatch—hull output will double overnight.

m29-hourglass-rescue.defeat_line: The hourglass empties as black tidewater swallows the lower vaults, drowning Oakhaven's last shipwrights.
m29-hourglass-rescue.codex_note: Freed from the drowning tidal vaults, Oakhaven's shipwrights worked beside Gorin's miners around the clock to double caravel construction at Harborwatch.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Highgate Bastion—guarding the landward approach to Harborwatch—stands scarred by three weeks of catapult fire while its starving garrison boils boot-leather for broth.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-corin-scout
intro_scene.line: Enemy trench-raiders hold both flanks of the ravine. Cut their twin supply columns first, reclaim our iron-plated grain wagons, and shatter the Redoubt Commander!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Cut their supply escorts and drive the grain through Highgate's gate.

milestones.speaker: npc-corin-scout
milestones.line: Both enemy supply columns butchered—iron-plated grain wagons and six hundred coins recovered!

milestones.speaker: npc-corin-scout
milestones.line: Storm the valley redoubt and ignite Highgate's green signal flares!

ambient_barks: Protect the grain wagons!
Starve their redoubt!
Light the green flares!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-corin-scout
victory_epilogue.line: The grain rolls through the gate and Highgate's green flares burn against the storm clouds. Harborwatch's outer ring holds!

m30-starved-bastion.defeat_line: Highgate Bastion starves and buckles, exposing Harborwatch's landward walls to siege.
m30-starved-bastion.codex_note: Held on boiled leather and rainwater for twenty-one days, Highgate Bastion's green relief flares became the signal that Harborwatch could still hold.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Roaring white-water sluices thunder beneath twin parallel stone riverlocks seized by corrupt canal mercenaries who extort silver for every freshwater cask bound for the fleet.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-hal-bridgewright
intro_scene.line: The Lockmaster is bleeding Harborwatch dry while ship casks sit empty! Capture both northern lock banks fast—and watch out when he cranks open the sluice torrents!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take the West and East Riverlocks, then throw the Lockmaster off the heights.

milestones.speaker: npc-hal-bridgewright
milestones.line: West Riverlock secured—four hundred and fifty silver coins pried from the toll masonry!

milestones.speaker: npc-hal-bridgewright
milestones.line: East Riverlock captured! Storm the heights and drop the Lockmaster!

ambient_barks: Hold your footing on the sluices!
Secure both riverlocks!
Water for the ships!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-hal-bridgewright
victory_epilogue.line: Fresh water roars back into Harborwatch's cisterns. Every evacuation caravel will sail with full casks!

m31-riverlock-crossing.defeat_line: The Lockmaster opens the floodgates, sweeping your company down the roaring canal while Harborwatch's casks stay dry.
m31-riverlock-crossing.codex_note: With Ironheart's mountain aquifers dry, the Twin Riverlocks above Harborwatch held the last clean freshwater for the trans-oceanic crossing.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: High above the pine line, rhythmic tremors shake pebbles off the fractured granite ridge around an ancient highland cairn.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
intro_scene.line: Ordinary steel shatters against its hide! Remember, it isn't a servant of the Caldera—it's the continent's own bedrock thrashing in tectonic pain. Silence it cleanly before its rockslides crush the harbor!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Focus earth-breaking magic and heavy bolts on its glowing chest-core.

milestones.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
milestones.line: Runic retainers pour out of the highland cairn—watch the fissures!

milestones.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
milestones.line: Its core is cracking—finish the twin granite wardens!

ambient_barks: Clear the rockslides!
Aim for the glowing core!
Shatter the granite wardens!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-kael-huntsman
victory_epilogue.line: The Elder Juggernaut settles back into silent stone, leaving a thousand ancient runic coins in its core. The mountain ridge above Harborwatch is still.

m32-elder-juggernaut.defeat_line: Crushed beneath cascading granite fissures, your vanguard falls silent beside the highland cairn.
m32-elder-juggernaut.codex_note: Scholars recorded that the Elder Juggernaut stirred only once every millennium—not in malice, but whenever Thornvael's crust began to tear apart.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Volcanic tremors rattle ancient dust from two golem-guarded reliquary crypts flanking the central pass fortress.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: These tremors will seal the vaults forever. Will you punch straight through the center to slay the Vault Keep Commander, or risk blood and time cracking the West and East Reliquary Crypts for ancestral steel and bullion?

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Keep shields tight—we take what the kings left behind and break the keep.

milestones.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
milestones.line: West Reliquary unsealed—one thousand sovereigns and an Elixir of Mind!
