milestones.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
milestones.line: East Reliquary cracked—one thousand ancient coins and an ancestral Knight's Broadsword!

ambient_barks: Breach the crypts before they collapse!
Watch the vault golems!
Take the central keep!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
victory_epilogue.line: The central keep collapses. Armed with the forgotten steel of Southern Kings, we march down to Harborwatch.

m33-high-stakes-gambit.defeat_line: Trapped by collapsing vault ceilings and stone wardens, your assault bleeds out in the pass.
m33-high-stakes-gambit.codex_note: The forgotten reliquaries of the Third Dynasty yielded both ancient bullion for the fleet and ancestral steel tempered for the coming volcano.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: The valley before Harborwatch has descended into savage madness as the Ironclad Banner and the fanatical Ashen Banner butcher one another over shipping manifests and boarding berths.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
intro_scene.line: Those vultures execute refugees caught in the crossfire while fighting over hulls they didn't build! Bait their elites into bleeding each other white, then trample both banners into the mud!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Let their vanguards collide, then sweep the valley clean.

milestones.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
milestones.line: Both warbands clash across the central field—strike while their lines are locked!

milestones.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
milestones.line: One banner down! Sweep the second camp before they rally!

ambient_barks: Trample both banners!
Protect the refugee road!
No berths for vultures!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: Both predatory banners lie in the mud. The final road into Harborwatch's war-docks stands open—and the harbor bells are already ringing!

m34-clashing-banners.defeat_line: Caught between two blood-mad armies, your vanguard is trampled in the mud before Harborwatch.
m34-clashing-banners.codex_note: When news spread that not everyone on the shore could sail west, discipline across the lesser warbands dissolved into the War of the Vultures.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: The sky turns blood-crimson over Harborwatch as hot volcanic ash falls like sleet onto boiling pitch, frantic harbor bells, and families sprinting up the final gangplanks.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
intro_scene.line: Mutineers and cinder-beasts have breached the seawall! Clear the Burning Plaza and reinforce Marshal Veyra on the Western Evacuation Pier before torch-bearers burn the hulls!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
intro_scene.line: Hold the western gangplank, Commander! Two more caravels are still taking on children from Sera's tents—nothing with a torch crosses these flagstones!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Keep the winches turning, Marshal! We'll hold this pier until the last rope is cut—then take Lord-Captain Korvus on the Eastern War Pier.

milestones.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
milestones.line: Berserkers with oil-torches are rushing the gangplanks—Miner Gorin's ironstone plates are holding, keep them off the timber quay!

milestones.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
milestones.line: They are away! May the salt winds carry them past the Western Rim! Now, Commander—let us show Korvus and his vultures how the rearguard of Thornvael fights!

ambient_barks: Hold the Western Pier!
Protect Marshal Veyra!
Cut Korvus's chains!
For the departing fleet!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The people are safe. Their dawn is on the water. We have bought them their morning—now let us march east into the night of the Obsidian Caldera.

m35-burning-harbor.defeat_line: Marshal Veyra falls upon the burning timber quay as oil-torches turn the last evacuation caravels into floating pyres.
m35-burning-harbor.codex_note: With the evacuation armada safely beyond the Western Rim, the surviving rearguard turned their backs on the empty harbor and marched fifty leagues east toward the volcano.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Razor-cold alpine wind whistles across the granite spine of Highcrest Citadel, where blue wardstones hum above falling gray cinder-snow.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: With the fleet safely beyond the horizon, no one left is fighting out of panic. Rearm at Elda's meteoric forge, sweep the Iron Pact scouts from the ash-draped trail, and shatter the Northern Pass ambush!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
intro_scene.line: My Harborwatch veterans are locked beside your mountain column, Vance. Show us the pass.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take Tier 5 meteoric steel from Elda's forge and force the Northern Pass.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Forward scout screen shattered—four hundred silver florins recovered in the ash!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Watch the granite switchbacks—gorge defenders are closing on the column!

ambient_barks: Push the Northern Pass!
Meteoric steel holds!
Watch the ridge walls!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The Northern Pass is ours. Ahead, blinding violet light seals the valley floor.

m36-heartland-march.defeat_line: Cut down on the ash-draped switchbacks, the rearguard never reaches the Obsidian Caldera.
m36-heartland-march.codex_note: Highcrest Citadel stood on the razor granite spine dividing the coastal lowlands from the volcanic plateau, lashed simultaneously by mountain frost and rising caldera heat.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Three towering runic beacons project a blinding dome of violet lightning across the valley floor, vaporizing anything crossing the obsidian flats.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: Ward-Scholar Elowen and Chronicler Zahra decoded the harmonic frequencies behind these pylons. Strike West, Center, and East in sequence to shatter their interlocking grid!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Bring down all three beacon garrisons and brace for the valley floor counter-surge.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: West Beacon down! Center pylon is arcing violently!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Two beacons shattered—Iron Pact reserves surge across the valley floor!

ambient_barks: Thank Zahra's notes—hit the pylons!
Collapse the violet grid!
Hold against the surge!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The blinding glare snaps out—look up from Highcrest's line! For the first time, the black silhouette of the Infernal Citadel looms through the ash.

m37-shattered-beacons.defeat_line: Arcing violet lightning vaporizes your column across the shattered obsidian flats.
m37-shattered-beacons.codex_note: Using Chronicler Zahra's Redmarsh quartz measurements and Ward-Scholar Elowen's coastal harmonics, allied sappers collapsed the Iron Pact's outer lightning grid.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Greystone Bastion—the sole highland artery into the inner caldera—groans under the thunder of iron-plated siege cohorts.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Three Iron Pact cohorts are converging at once: ladder berserkers, cliffside rappellers, and colossal Stonebreaker war-golems! Hold the gatehouse beside my garrison!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Hold the parapet and break every cohort against Greystone's walls.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Cohort one broken—flanking raiders are rappelling down the razor-cliffs!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Stonebreakers! Iron-plated war-golems charging straight for the timber gatehouse!

ambient_barks: Hold Greystone's gate!
Cut the cliff ropes!
Shatter the Stonebreakers!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Greystone's banners stay upright! The Iron Pact's field siege host lies shattered at our gate.

m38-besieged-wall.defeat_line: Stonebreaker rams shatter Greystone's timber gatehouse, severing the rearguard's sole artery into the Caldera.
m38-besieged-wall.codex_note: Captain Rowan's garrison held Greystone Bastion through relentless ash-storms so the main column could hunt down Arch-Mage Malrik.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: A lone hooded figure sprints up the jagged switchbacks of Ashveil Gorge, clutching a scorched leather satchel toward a humming summit teleportation shrine.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: That is Arch-Mage Malrik—the grand conspirator who leaked the northern border ciphers and sold Thornvael to the Iron Pact! Cut him down before he reaches the shrine!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Push up the switchbacks through the cliff-snipers and take those ledgers.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Malrik breaks past the mid-gorge bend—cliff-snipers are dropping from the rocks!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: He is bolting for the summit flagstones—stop his incantation!

ambient_barks: Don't let Malrik reach the shrine!
Watch the cliff-snipers!
Seize his satchel!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
victory_epilogue.line: The Royal Cipher-Keys and the Iron Pact Ledger! Look at the seal—Morvessa's northern Salt Tithe was meant to reinforce the Order Seals in the Crown Vault until the Iron Pact hijacked the treasury and woke the Caldera!

m39-flight-of-malrik.defeat_line: Malrik steps into the summit teleport circle, vanishing with the cipher-ledgers that held Thornvael's last truth.
m39-flight-of-malrik.codex_note: Spread across Highcrest's war table by Archivist Orla, Malrik's stolen ledgers finally connected the burned Border Mint of Act I to the awakening of the Obsidian Caldera.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Howling thermal updrafts rattle iron suspension chains between West Crag and East Crag—twin black fortress towers straddling a mile-deep volcanic chasm.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: Both crags command the lone causeway to the Infernal Citadel. Burn both bastions—the instant one tower falls, the opposing crag will launch an armored counter-charge!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Cross the swaying spans, burn both bastions, and crush their reserve column.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: First crag fallen—their reserve relief column charges across the chasm causeway!

ambient_barks: Mind the chasm wind!
Burn both crags!
Meet the counter-charge!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: Allied standards whip in the thermal gale above both peaks. The abyss is crossed.

m40-twofold-assault.defeat_line: Hurled off the groaning chasm causeways by war-golems, the vanguard plunges into the volcanic abyss.
m40-twofold-assault.codex_note: Spanning a mile-deep fault in the Obsidian Caldera, the Twin Crags were built to let a hundred Iron Pact defenders hold back an empire.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: White-hot crossbow quarrels spark off narrow black canyon walls above bubbling pitch trenches and roaring mortar bastions.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: Every pace of the Gauntlet of Iron is a pre-ranged kill-zone! Keep tower shields locked over your mages, smash the First Gate, cross the Crossfire Pit, and cut down the Gauntlet Commander at the Iron Bridge!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Advance in locked formation—shield the arcanists until the mortar bastions fall silent.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: First Gate splintered—three hundred and fifty silver crowns recovered from the guardpost!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Crossfire Pit! Golems and battle-mages converge from the pitch trenches!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Silence the bridge guard and force the Iron Bridge!

ambient_barks: Shields up against the quarrels!
Clear the Crossfire Pit!
Storm the Iron Bridge!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The Gauntlet Commander falls into the slag trench. Before us rises the three-hundred-foot basalt wall of the Infernal Citadel.

m41-gauntlet-of-iron.defeat_line: Pinned inside the Crossfire Pit beneath mortar fire and boiling pitch, your column burns inside its plate.
m41-gauntlet-of-iron.codex_note: Combined-arms discipline forged at Oakhaven and Highcrest proved decisive inside the Gauntlet of Iron, where shields sheltered arcanists long enough to silence the ridge mortars.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Three-hundred-foot black basalt walls pulse with incandescent violet ley-light beneath a blood-red sky as iron war-drums vibrate through every shield.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
intro_scene.line: My Harborwatch veterans didn't watch the fleet sail west just to stall at a moat! Vance and I will lead the diversion along the main wall—breach at least two of the three gatehouses to crack the Inner Bailey!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: Once two gates collapse, their entire veteran inner garrison will pour down to meet us. Leave nothing in reserve!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Tear open two gatehouses and break the Inner Bailey garrison.

milestones.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
milestones.line: One gatehouse shattered! Keep pressing—Vance's coastal veterans are holding the diversion!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: The rampart is breached! The Inner Bailey's veteran garrison charges out!

ambient_barks: For the fleet that sailed!
Breach two gatehouses!
Into the Inner Bailey!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The basalt rampart breaks! The doorway into the heart of the volcano stands open—now hold our rear!

m42-outer-rampart.defeat_line: Broken against the three-hundred-foot basalt wall, the rearguard's banners sink beneath the ley-lit moat.
m42-outer-rampart.codex_note: Side by side beneath the Outer Rampart, Marshal Vance's mountain guard and Marshal Veyra's Harborwatch veterans fought their final pitched battle together.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Seeing their rampart breached, three massive Iron Pact siege columns converge upon Three-Roads Watch to sever Vance's rear supply line and trap the army inside the caldera.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-tessa-warden
intro_scene.line: North, west, and east columns are closing on the crossroads redoubt! Hold the center beside my cavalry, break all three columns, then counter-march north to raze their staging camp!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Break all three columns, then smash their northern staging reserve.

milestones.speaker: npc-tessa-warden
milestones.line: All three assault columns shattered! Counter-march north and burn their staging reserve!

ambient_barks: Hold Three-Roads Watch!
Protect the supply line!
Counter-march north!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-tessa-warden
victory_epilogue.line: The Iron Pact's last field reserves are annihilated! Our rear is secure—descend into the Threshold Chamber, commander.

m43-three-roads-siege.defeat_line: With Three-Roads Watch overrun, the allied army inside the Infernal Citadel is cut off and crushed.
m43-three-roads-siege.codex_note: Warden Tessa's defense of Three-Roads Watch ensured that no matter what happened inside the Threshold Chamber, the Iron Pact could never rally an army again.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Far beneath the sundered bailey lies the octagonal Threshold Chamber of the Crown Vault, where blinding orange magma and bone-freezing blue stasis hang in silent balance.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
intro_scene.line: The fleets are safe, Commander, yet the continent's heart still screams beneath us. To the west stands the Altar of Order, where Korrath waits in petrified stasis; to the east burns the Furnace Heart of Vorak. Step onto your chosen stone—there is no turning back.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Sweep the Threshold Wardens aside. We answer the final question ourselves.

milestones.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
milestones.line: The Threshold Chamber falls quiet. Step onto the West Altar for Crown of Order, or the East Altar for Ember Reckoning.

ambient_barks: Break the Threshold Wardens!
Order or Ember!
The fate of Thornvael waits!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
victory_epilogue.line: The irreversible step is taken. May the world endure your reckoning.

m44-threshold-choice.defeat_line: Struck down between fire and frost, your blood cools on the Threshold flagstones while Thornvael burns unchallenged.

optional_choice.prompt: Between the West Altar of Order and the East Altar of Ember, which vision will govern Thornvael's future?
optional_choice.a: Step onto the West Altar of Order — shatter petrified tyranny and let a fragile mortal world heal.
optional_choice.b: Step onto the East Altar of Ember — break the Furnace Heart and bind the realm under an unyielding Crown.
optional_choice.effect_a: Unlocks m45: Crown of Order (Ending A — The Purging of Thornvael).
optional_choice.effect_b: Unlocks m46: Ember Reckoning (Ending B — Rise of the Dark Sovereign).

m44-threshold-choice.codex_note: Carved at the exact geological heart where First Dynasty stasis met volcanic fire, the Threshold Chamber forced every arbiter of Thornvael to choose between renewal and dominion.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Inside the frozen marble cathedral of the Crown Vault, dust hangs motionless in pale azure light before Arch-Warden Korrath—the Living Law.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
intro_scene.line: Korrath's flesh turned to petrified granite over three centuries of vigil. He believes eternal stillness is the only cure for mortal suffering. Sunder the West and East Resonance Anchors with the Sigil of Order—or his blades will execute us in the name of silence!

intro_scene.speaker: arch-warden-korrath
intro_scene.line: Mortal freedom is only a prettier word for slaughter. Come—learn the mercy of stone.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Sunder both resonance anchors and break his petrified law.

milestones.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
milestones.line: West Resonance Anchor fractured under the Sigil of Order!

milestones.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
milestones.line: Both anchors sundered! Watch his twin white-granite greatswords—avoid Petrifying Stasis!

ambient_barks: Sunder the anchors!
Cleanse the petrifying stasis!
Let Thornvael live free!

victory_epilogue.speaker: narrator
victory_epilogue.line: Golden-blue light pours from Korrath's splitting granite breastplate as the necrotic tether snaps cleanly, cooling molten slag into harmless black basalt.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
victory_epilogue.line: The sky above the caldera is clearing—for the first time in an age, it is blue.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Send word to the western sea. The fleet can come home.

m45-crown-of-order.defeat_line: Turned to motionless white stone inside the Crown Vault, you join three centuries of silent imperial statues.
m45-crown-of-order.codex_note: By shattering Arch-Warden Korrath's resonance anchors rather than claiming his stasis, the arbiter trusted an imperfect mortal world to rebuild its own dawn.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Blinding orange magma roars beneath an obsidian altar in the Furnace Heart, where Ember Overlord Vorak guards the blazing Crown of Thorns and Cinder.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
intro_scene.line: Vorak sees humanity as slag and our cities as fuel for the Great Cleansing! Break the West and East Obsidian Conduit Pillars feeding his throne—or he will turn the entire continent into an open crematorium!

intro_scene.speaker: ember-overlord-vorak
intro_scene.line: You watched kings fail and harbors burn! Step into my kiln and prove your bones can hold a crown!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Demolish both conduits. Never again will traitors or weak treaties break this realm.

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: West Conduit Pillar cracked! Cinder-imps erupt from the fissure!

milestones.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
milestones.line: Both conduits shattered! Vorak's black plate liquefies into white-hot slag—dodge the meteors!

ambient_barks: Shatter the conduit pillars!
Dodge the magma waves!
Seize the Furnace Heart!

victory_epilogue.speaker: narrator
victory_epilogue.line: Vorak sinks beneath the magma, leaving the Crown of Thorns and Cinder blazing upon the obsidian altar. Remembering Thornwick, Redmarsh, and Harborwatch, you lift it onto your brow.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
victory_epilogue.line: The fissures are sealing into black glass—they are obeying your hand.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Raise the crimson banners from the Border Fords to the Obsidian Peaks. Never again.

m46-ember-reckoning.defeat_line: Consumed by Vorak's molten wrath, nothing remains of your vanguard save blackened ash upon the altar.
m46-ember-reckoning.codex_note: Forged in the primordial fire of the Obsidian Caldera, the Crown of Thorns and Cinder bound every leyline of Thornvael to a single sovereign will.
